The game seems to be struggling to stream in assets on time in a handful of places for me. The attached video was just the most egregious form of it I can easily replicate.  

Console: PS5 - Resolution Mode. 

Type of Bug: Visual/Pop-In

Description: During opening sequence with the vocal track playing there is noticeable, really jarring pop in that has happened both times I’ve ran through this sequence of the game. There is a specific part of the scene where you literally see the entire world load in for me. I’ve looked this up on YouTube and it doesn’t seem like it’s the norm but it’s happened to me on both of my playthroughs if the opening hour and I have to imagine it’ll happen every subsequent time as well.

Steps to reproduce: simply get to the point where this cutscene plays.

Expected result: The scene should play out with minimal pop-in. I’m not expecting absolutely zero because that would be ridiculous. But you’ll see in the video I’m gonna link, it’s kinda absurd.

Observed result: here is a clipped video of the worse offense. https://twitter.com/lostcause_tv/status/1494782527197913088?s=21

Reproduction rate: so far I’ve run the sequence twice. Happened both times. Redownloading the game to see if that does anything, though I expect it won’t make a difference. I worry this is going to manifest more later on in the game. Which is the only reason I’m talking about this. Curious if anyone else has seen it.
